newsitem.title: UK: BFI unchanged, US Gulf grain still firm.
newsitem.headline: BFI unchanged, US Gulf grain still firm.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was unchanged on Monday at 1,523 points with brokers reporting continuing firm conditions for vessels able to load grain in the US Gulf for December/first half Jan.

They reported Irene 65,671 dwt fixed by Skydragon delivery retrospective to sailing Piraeus December 11 for trip via US Gulf to China with grain at a very firm $16,450 daily (this vessel can give December arrival USGulf).

The firmer tone in the Atlantic was offset by slightly softer conditions in the North PAcific. Continental fixed North Princess 71,200 dwt delivery Pacific North West early Jan to load grain to Japan at $11,250 daily plus $200,000 bonus.

Brokers said there have been a number of short period timecharter fixtures of Panamaxes in the Far East from which owners derived encouragement that present firm markret levels for these types of vessel will be sustained.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was unchanged to three points lower and turnover totalled only 17 lots.
